zoe: Kickoff: short refapp bundle + one benchmark card + 20-min webinar. Goal: quick dev wins and outbound signups.
marco: Agree. Propose 3 micro-tutorials: auth, embed search, rerank. each = 10-15min read.
li: I'll own embed search + bench. want a single clear stat for socials but with testbed note.
marco: i'll do auth + small sample app. can draft a TRANSLATE.md for contributors.
zoe: timeline: publish in 9 business days, webinar a week later. Owners, confirm?
li: confirmed. bench plan: p50/p95 + cost/sample for two infra configs. will include reproducible script.
sendgrid-bot: New list created: "micro-refapps-2024" webhook https://hooks.redwood.ai/inbound/micro-refapps-2024
zoe: inbound routing: tag registrants with "micro-refapps" and capture utm. add a 1-question pre-survey: "primary use case".
marco: social assets: teaser, bench-card, CTA to register. i'll mock 3 copy variants.
li: suggestion: soft-launch to 20 contributors for translation QA for 48 hours.
zoe: do that. recap: zoe=lead ops, marco=auth+social, li=embed+bench. deadline publish by 1756800000. next check-in Friday 9am PT.
